rng.algorithm: SplitMix64 [Steele2014]: state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z = state; z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EB; return z ^ (z >> 31)

rng.draw_order: fixed 64x64: one draw per row word; tiled matrices: one draw per bit in row-major order, low bit used; buffers: one draw per word, source s uses seed + s
rng.seeds: the workload seed of each addendum cell; the framing/mapping checks use the literal seeds in this script

m4ri.mapping: output[c][r] = input[r][c]; row words use bit c = 1u64 << c
m4ri.padding: M4RI keeps excess bits of a non-window matrix zero (mzd.h policy); the dumps read only valid bits
m4ri.aliasing: distinct input/output; the kernel-isolated cell reuses a preallocated output, whole-consumer calls allocate a fresh one

bitshuffle.unavailable_reason: element count (rows) is not a multiple of 8
bitshuffle.adapter: rows padded to a multiple of 8 and packed into ceil(cols/8)-byte elements; one block of size rows_padded; the first cols planes are unpacked into the canonical cols x rows output; pack/unpack copies skipped when the layouts coincide
bitshuffle.aliasing: distinct input/output as required by the Bitshuffle interface

logical_xor.mapping: dest[w].bit[b] = XOR over sources of src[s][w].bit[b], LSB-first
logical_xor.isa_l_parity_arity: vects = sources + 1; two sources (vects 3) in the sized cells, three sources (vects 4) in the arity cell
logical_xor.unaligned: unavailable: raid.h requires source and destination pointers aligned to 32 bytes; the harness refuses other alignments
logical_xor.arrangement_cost: the pointer array is formed inside every timed call and its formation alone, averaged over one million repetitions outside the timed windows, is reported as dispatch_ns; the gf2 fresh-destination copy is inside every timed call and, averaged the same way, reported as pack_ns
logical_xor.aliasing: unavailable: raid.h names distinct source pointers and one destination pointer; gf2's dst ^= src accumulate has no ISA-L equivalent

bch_genmatrix.equivalence: full-rank row-space equality after both documented layouts are reindexed to internal polynomial-degree order
bch_genmatrix.raw_dump_identity: falsified; bases and systematic column layouts differ
